durations.instrument: gh api repos/tvofi/heatpump_optimizer/commits/<sha>/check-runs over the last main merges

model.carry_provenance: p75 hours over 43 second-or-later part PRs (first commit or creation to merge); carries_per_part is the p90 of roster carries a part body cites as answered over the 20 that cite any (size_durations.cited_carries): a part's capacity, since a part's hours do not grow with its carries. held_open_carries: each carries-open group's carries no merged body of its own cites, at measurement; replan.py counts any carry appended since as open
model.sizes_provenance: p75 over 189 done groups with a merged PR (S n=123, M n=49, L n=11, XL n=6): active hours (the union of each part's first commit or creation, or the roster's dispatch stamp, to its merge) with extra review rounds priced out at the pooled Theil-Sen slope (4.62 h/round), then the cell's mean rounds added back; per class where a cell has n>=5. Wall clock: review, queueing and the PR-less handoff wait are inside it. carry_hours (0.33 h) is the Theil-Sen slope of the round-adjusted hours on the group's carry count, priced per carry above the size's median (carry_baseline). Monotone in size: XL 31 h lifted to L's 31.1 h. Measured by tools/plan/size_durations.py; re-derive, never edit.
